SUBJECTS_dewback_reconcile.title: Dewback: one lizard, one set — game art
SUBJECTS_dewback_reconcile.lead_html: The dewback's art was split across cards: every render job showed only the facings it drew (east-only, north+south-only, south-only), so no card ever held a whole lizard. The reconcile_v1_dewback column joins the east regen of your picked longshade (your 10-09 note: make North and South versions of that creature) with the north/south you picked today (D). The IN GAME column is what is installed now. canon_dewback_v1 is the only other complete three-facing set (September, outlined style). Pick the set to install; nothing is installed until you rule.
